qarun.name: Qarun
qarun.title: Qarun (Korah)
qarun.dict: One of Moses' people, so rich that the keys of his treasures weighed down a band of strong men. He says, "I was given all this on account of knowledge I possess", and the earth swallows him and his house (28:76-82). He is named with Pharaoh and Haman (29:39, 40:24).

queen-of-sheba.name: The queen of Sheba
queen-of-sheba.title: The queen of Sheba
queen-of-sheba.dict: A queen who rules Sheba and worships the sun. Solomon writes to her; she comes to him, mistakes a floor of glass for water, and says, "I have submitted with Solomon, to God, Lord of the Worlds" (27:22-44). The Quran does not name her; later tradition calls her Bilqis.

quraysh.name: Quraysh
quraysh.title: Quraysh
quraysh.dict: The tribe of Mecca, and of Muhammad. Named once, in the surah that bears their name: for the safety of their caravans, "let them worship the Lord of this House" (106:1-4).
